episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: As the CEO of a top executive search firm, Kang Ji-yun scouts and recruits talent. Yoo Eun-ho is a thorn in her side, thwarting her recruitment goals.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Ji-yun is displeased with her new secretary, Eun-ho. As hard as he tries to ingratiate himself, Eun-ho can't seem to crack through her icy demeanor.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Eun-ho dwells on what he had seen at CareerWay. Meanwhile, he slowly adjusts to the headhunter life, and Ji-yun's chilly exterior starts to melt.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After learning what had gone down between Ji-yun and Hye-jin in the past, Eun-ho tries to cheer her up. The Peoples employees are abuzz with conflict.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After the dinner, Ji-yun finds her thoughts drifting to Eun-ho but refuses to entertain the idea. Oblivious to her unrest, Mi-ae arranges a meeting.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Ji-yun and Eun-ho spend the night at his house. Ever since then, something is brewing between them. Meanwhile, Su-hyeon's call sends Eun-ho running.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ji-yun now understands her feelings for Eun-ho. Her eyes are perpetually fixed on her secretary, and others in the office are starting to notice.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Once Ji-yun and Eun-ho confirm their feelings for each other, they begin a clandestine office romance. Ji-yun attends an event hosted by Chairman Woo.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Eun-ho comforts Ji-yun, and the two grow closer than ever. Ji-yun and Hye-jin compete head-to-head to appoint the CEO of a domestic industry giant.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Ji-yun learns that the child her father had saved back then was Eun-ho. In the light of this shocking truth, their relationship starts to crumble.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Peoplez takes a huge hit when they are suspected of being involved in an investment scam, and Ji-yoon and Eun-ho.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: When Ji-yun announces her resignation, the office falls into chaos. Confident in her defeat of Ji-yun, Hye-jin moves in to take over the Peoplez firm.
